research_notes: Follow up substantive full-time consulting periods and breaks, Farmshed tenure/secondment, PJP final date, and contract-level dates for Rabobank and university teaching. Distinguish agribusiness investment/board roles from any paid advisory work.

2026-09-29 avenues: APH occupation text, contemporaneous PJP/ANZ report, McKinsey ownership history, ASX July 2001 indexed filing, government-hosted speaker biography, public conference profile, ABC and business reporting, targeted full-time/early-career/Rabobank/EAI searches. ASX current page lacked announcement body; retained transparent indexed evidence. No paid registries or access restrictions bypassed.

Follow-up corporate leads, not confirmed employment spells: Centaurus Partners, Agricultural Managers Limited, Agriculture Managers Australia, Australian Agricultural Securitisation, Resolution Manager and JRAT. Search reporting describes directorships/consulting, but legal entities, contracts and paid activity require primary filings. Victorian gas taskforce is an advisory appointment lead, not automatically public-service employment.

No assumption that founding or owning a farm means full-time farming. Resolve 1998/1999 Growth Farms discrepancy and EAI resignation separately from EAA's 2009 end. Dates and senior titles alone do not establish hours. All consulting, directorship and educational overlaps remain non-additive. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; initial record unresolved.

2026-10-01 follow-up: resolved college council1999–2014 via own public post; distinguished Rabobank2012 Executive Development Program appointment from broad1998 farm-programme entry; added contemporaneously documented Victorian gas advisory taskforce. Secondary interests transcription records occasional presentations, not continuous bank employment. No hours or numeric total inferred.

Avenues: employer Rabobank2012 press release/index, college public professional-network post,2013 ABC taskforce membership, linked44P interests original403, Farmshed ASX and corporate-report leads, full-time consulting searches, Centaurus/JRAT reporting and farm-manager programme history. Source searches sometimes returned irrelevant names; rejected. Corporate reportage does not independently show Taylor personally performed paid consulting for Centaurus; report authorship by a firm is insufficient. Keep JRAT, other corporate offices, historical Farmshed contracts, consulting leave and paid teaching as follow-up needs. Gas final-report obsolete URLs not recovered. Secondary ownership/dividend dates are not work boundaries.

Second follow-up2October2026: public first-party professional-profile index refines McKinsey and PJP dates to months; direct999 respected. Contemporary October2002 Farmshed sale reporting identifies CEO and a management offer; no accepted new employment inferred. Added Farmsmart directorship with unbounded personal tenure. Reporting places Farm Partnerships establishment2003 versus grouped official1998; retain discrepancy pending entity/role-specific primary record. Farmshed secondary reports conflict on administration2002/2005 and director periods; not used as CEO boundaries. Gas taskforce report searches found later parliamentary policy reports but no original appointment record. Next: public original corporate appointment extracts, McKinsey/PJP contract/leave evidence, Farmshed transition and Rabobank/teaching service arrangements. No full-time totals calculated.

Third follow-up3October2026: recovered the complete25July2001 ASX-hosted Colloqui/The Farmshed announcement previously available only as an index. It directly establishes Taylor acting as CEO of The Farmshed Pty Limited, discussing its professional advisory services and using a company contact, but remains only a point-in-time observation and supplies no start, end, hours, leave or McKinsey secondment terms. Renewed EAI, Farm Partnerships, Rabobank and PJP searches returned secondary corporate/governance dates or facts already recorded; no further employment boundary was adopted.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: targeted Farmshed transition, Port Jackson Partners commencement and Rabobank searches recovered a2008 PJP submission hosted by the National Competition Council stating that Taylor worked at McKinsey1994–2001 and began with PJP in2002. This corroborates, but does not improve on, the already recorded employer report and month-level public profile dates. ASX search repeated the25July2001 Farmshed CEO point; no sale filing, secondment terms, individual hours, leave, exact CEO boundaries or accepted purchaser role emerged.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added missing JRAT/Centaurus and Resolution founding-director roles from identified investigative reporting, including quoted personal confirmation of JRAT2004–2015. Original extract images’ ordinary download returned403; exact-day secondary claims not adopted. Resolution legal-name variation and departure remain unresolved. Rural Press’s original18October2002 ASX address confirms Farmshed business sale, but company sale is not Taylor’s personal CEO end or accepted purchaser employment. No individual hours/leave established.

Follow-up 2026-10-05: targeted Farmshed CEO transition, Rabobank programme service and original Victorian Gas Market Taskforce report searches using both engines returned the existing 2001 ASX point, official chronology and derivative report citations. No accepted purchaser role, CEO boundary, teaching contract, consulting leave or full-time work interval emerged. Australian Farm Institute 2014 speaker-profile PDF https://www.farminstitute.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/FAF2014_speakers.pdf was an archival lead; retrieval returned HTTP400 Timeout fetching, so no contents or personal appointment fact claimed. Gas taskforce original remains unrecovered; do not use report publication as personal tenure. Other peoples press-secretary full-time wording and arbitrary January dates from derivative databases rejected. Existing ownership/governance roles remain separate from paid activity. Await original firm/personnel or programme contract records rather than repeat generic searches.

Second targeted pass recovered originalAFI2014 speaker PDF through web reader; prior400source failure recovered, ordinary download403 not bypassed.
